'''Verpine shatter guns''', also known as '''Verps''', were handheld projectile weapons ranging in scale from handguns to rifles produced by the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] species. Due to their silent and precise nature, they were highly coveted weapons by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and notably [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors. They operated similar to [[Railgun/Legends|railguns]], using [[Magnetic coil|magnetic coils]] to silently fire [[Slug/Legends|slugs]] at extreme velocities capable of penetrating [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn-class Armor]] and dealing large kinetic damage. Though, its successor, the [[Mark II Katarn-class commando armor|Mark II Katarn-class Armor]], could not be penetrated by Verpines.<ref>"Fi’s armored breastplate puffed a cloud of coating with a loud crack, and he fell back against the wall of their quarters. Verps were silent except for the impact and the screaming that sometimes followed the blasts. Fi wasn’t screaming. But behind his visor, he had his mouth open in a silent oh of pain." -[[Karen Traviss]] [[Omega Squad: Targets]] 1</ref> Shatter guns were considered highly versatile, with [[Kal Skirata]] joking that he could fire small rocks out of his if he needed to.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Alongside this, they were capable of reducing their power coils, which slowed the velocity of the projectile.<ref>"''Relax. Power Coil set to medium. Don't want her to feel the projectile hit her. Don't want to spray the Dust over the whole plaza either...''" -[[Karen Traviss]] [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]] 265</ref>

However, Verpines were considered very fragile and vulnerable to quick movement, in Kal Skirata's words, "They do not bounce." Accompanying this unfortunate downside, they were vulnerable to [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] attacks as a result of their reliance on [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]].<ref>[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]</ref>

==Variants==
===Verpine Sniper Rifle===
The '''Verpine sniper rifle''' was an expensive, top-of-the-line sniper rifle based on the Verpine shatter gun design. The Mandalorian bounty hunter [[Kal Skirata]] favored Verpine sniper rifles, personally owning several expensive models. [[Omega Squad]] used Verpine sniper rifles during an anti-terrorism mission on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to eliminate several [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terrorist cells who had infiltrated the capital. The commandos used the rifles to tag suspect terrorists with [[Dust]] in order to track them.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:VerpSniper.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Raymond Ramirez's Verpine Sniper Rifle model.]]
[[Raymond Ramirez]], a U.S. soldier and fan with a special connection to [[Karen Traviss]], made a custom-made Verpine Sniper Rifle with a [[bipod]] at Traviss' request, which she posted on her website.<ref name="Traviss Website">{{WebCite|url=http://karentraviss.livejournal.com|text=Karen Traviss' website|author=[[Karen Traviss]]|work=karentraviss.livejournal.com|archivedate=20060428080022}}</ref> Ramirez's blog has been featured on [[StarWars.com]], where a smaller image of the Verpine sniper rifle with bipod can be found.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/blog/news20060727.html|text=Featured Blog: ''Mando'ade and Their Toys''}}</ref> One of his blog entries goes deep into the weapon's functions.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|Mando-ramser|36|The Verpine Sniper Weapon System...}}</ref>
